[ This is a second-price (Vickrey) auction with independent private values. The dominant strategy is to bid your true value: it maximizes expected profit regardless of others’ strategies. Overbidding risks winning and paying above value if others’ second-highest bid exceeds 16; underbidding risks losing when winning would have yielded positive surplus. There’s no useful history (round 1 of 1), and values are redrawn each round. Therefore, bid exactly your value, respecting $0.1 increments. ]
